Built-in Detachable Type-C Cable
–

Cable Doubles as Carry Loop
–
Use the flexible cable as a handy loop to hang/carry the power bank on bags or hooks; snaps back securely into the body after use.
22.5W Fast Charging
–
Quick, efficient power via the inbuilt Type-C cable and USB-A port; ideal for fast top-ups on the go.
Dual Output, Charge 2 Devices
–
Power two gadgets at once: use the built-in Type-C cable + USB-A port for simultaneous charging.
Bidirectional Type-C (In/Out) Refuel
–
Recharge the power bank quickly through the top Type-C PD port, and also use it to charge devices.
10,000mAh Slim & Travel-Friendly
–
Compact, lightweight battery capacity for a full day’s backup without bulk; pocketable design with LED battery indicators.
Important Note( Dummy Type C Port)-
The Type-C slot on the side is a dummy docking port designed only to park the built-in cable. It does not charge or transfer power/data. For charging, use the top Type-C PD port and/or the USB-A port

1.5 Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Can I change the shipping address of my order?
A: Orders can be edited or canceled only before the shipment via our customer support team shopify.us@baseus.com .We cannot change the shipment information once the product is en route.
Q: The logistics track has not been updated after shipment. What should I do?
A: If the logistics track has not been updated after 7 days, please contact us. If within 7 days, please wait patiently.
Q: Why did I only receive part of my order?
A: We might have divided your order into several packages. Perhaps those packages are delivered on different time. Please wait 7 days and contact us for logistic tracking.
Q:When logistics information indicates that the package has been delivered, but nothing arrives, what should I do?
A: It is recommended that first you call the local post office to confirm and check the surrounding environment again for parcels. Please contact us, we would love to help you.
Q: How will my delivery be shipped?
A: Amazon functions as our logistics partner to ship out Baseus products. They will choose the carrier that they think works best for our customers.
Q: Why is my order being shipped from an Amazon?
A:
We keep a portion of our inventory at Amazon fulfillment centers. As a result, some orders will be delivered through Amazon’s logistics network to ensure you receive fast and reliable shipping service.
Q: What do I need to do when I received a different product instead of what I ordered?

- Within 30 business days of receiving a product if the product has a manufacturing defect.

Order number

- Warranty claims on items taken outside the original country of purchase

- Returning incorrect items
- Returning items claimed to have defects but found by Baseus quality control to be in working condition
- Returning defective items in international shipping
- Costs associated with unauthorized returns (any returns made outside of the approved warranty process)
If the shipping item is over $39, please consider using a shipping service that provides tracking, or purchasing shipping insurance. Otherwise, Baseus cannot guarantee items are successfully returned.
2.4 Refund Policy
All refunds will be processed within 3 business days after the warehouse confirms receipt of the returned items. After we issue the refund, it may take up to 7-15 business days to reflect in your original payment method.
If you haven't received your refund for a long time after we process your refund, please check with the paying bank.

- Lost or stolen products
- Labels, machine serial numbers, waterproof marks, anti-counterfeiting marks, etc. torn up or altered.

Universal Compatibility
